title: The Road for the Biggest Trucks
synopsis: The friends visit the coastal Star Harbor project by county highway. Dump trucks, a grader and a roller begin a heavy-access road for rockets and transporters.
continuity_state: Before: Star Harbor is an active but unfinished coastal project far beyond Brook Road, reached by the county highway; no truck route passes Little Bridge. After: The special heavy-access road is under construction; Mr. Fred has delivered aggregate for its prepared layers. Star Harbor remains an adult worksite.
